description: This Java source file defines the class ShareProductHelper, which provides methods to build, manage, and verify share product data for integration testing in the Apache Fineract project. It includes functionality for creating share product JSON payloads, setting accounting rules, adding charges, market prices, and verifying the created share product data structures.

classes.name: ShareProductHelper
classes.description: Helper class for constructing, managing, and verifying share product data in integration tests.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing the share product data based on current object fields.

methods.name: withCashBasedAccounting
methods.description: Sets the accounting rule to cash-based without account list.

methods.name: withCashBasedAccounting
methods.description: Sets the accounting rule to cash-based with specified account list.

methods.name: withMarketPrice
methods.description: Adds dummy market price periods to the share product.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Attaches charges to the share product from a list of charge IDs.

methods.name: verifyShareProduct
methods.description: Verifies that the given share product data matches the helper's current values.

methods.name: getAccountMappingForCashBased
methods.description: Generates account ID mappings based on provided account list for cash-based accounting.
